envelope.description: Record the baseline, add the shared implied-story rule and point the tracker resolver at it

body.title: Record the baseline, add the shared implied-story rule and point the tracker resolver at it
body.summary: Before any edit, run the workflow and MCP test subsets and the type check and record the result as the baseline for this Story. Then in src/workflow/storage.ts, next to readEpicDefinitionCore, add the exported constant IMPLIED_ISSUE_STORY_ID ('s1') and impliedIssueStories(issue) returning the single { id, title } entry. Change src/workflow/tracker/resolve.ts storyEvidence (the 'implied' branch) to compare against the constant instead of the literal. Behaviour is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: the baseline result of npx tsx --test 'src/workflow/**/*.test.ts' 'src/mcp/**/*.test.ts' and of the type check is recorded before any source edit
impliedIssueStories returns exactly one entry whose id is IMPLIED_ISSUE_STORY_ID and whose title is the ISSUE title
tracker/resolve.ts has no literal 's1' for the implied rule and still answers implied for s1 and null for s2 on an ISSUE-anchored item
the existing tracker resolver tests still pass

tests.name: implied-issue-stories.test.ts: impliedIssueStories returns exactly one entry with id IMPLIED_ISSUE_STORY_ID and the ISSUE title
implied-issue-stories.test.ts: the tracker resolver answers implied for s1 and null for s2 from the shared constant
